text: ACCOMPLISHMENT Cut Taxes and Protected the Middle Class Last year, Governor Moore cut taxes for the middle-class, with 94% getting a tax break or having no changes on their tax bill. This year, Governor Moore turned a projected $1.5 billion cash shortfall into a $250 million surplus with no new taxes or fees, all while maintaining strong fiscal discipline and long-term stability for the state. Learn More

ACCOMPLISHMENT Delivered Record Reductions in Violent Crime Under Governor Moore and LG Miller, Maryland has seen dramatic improvements in public safety, including a 44% drop in homicides and a 40% drop in non-fatal shootings statewide. Baltimore City recorded its lowest number of homicides in nearly 50 years, driven by historic funding for law enforcement and public safety resources. The Moore-Miller administration has also advanced criminal justice reforms, including expanding eligibility for record expungement to help more Marylanders access jobs and Learn More

ACCOMPLISHMENT Expanded Access to Affordable Healthcare Governor Moore has taken action to make healthcare more accessible and affordable for Marylanders by expanding coverage, making efforts to lower the cost of prescription drugs, removing barriers to care, and requiring insurers to cover recommended vaccines. His administration is focused on ensuring more families can get the care they need, regardless of their zipcode. Learn More

ACCOMPLISHMENT Improved Government Efficiency and Cut Waste Governor Moore launched a Government Modernization Initiative to streamline state operations, cut red tape, and deliver services more effectively. These efforts are already saving taxpayers an estimated $50 million in a single fiscal year while making government work better for Marylanders. Learn More

ACCOMPLISHMENT Invested Historic Amounts in Public Education For four consecutive years, the Moore-Miller administration has delivered record funding for public schools, including a $10.2 billion investment in K-12 education this year alone. These investments are improving outcomes statewide, with gains in reading and math scores and a 58% reduction in teacher vacancies. Learn More

ACCOMPLISHMENT Jumpstarted Maryland’s Economy After years of stagnation, Maryland has created over 55,000 new businesses – with new establishments growing 39% faster than before the pandemic. The Moore-Miller administration has also secured major economic wins, including a $2 billion AstraZeneca expansion and the new Sphere National Harbor projected to bring in over $1 billion annually and create thousands of jobs. Learn More

ACCOMPLISHMENT Made Energy More Affordable and Accelerated Clean Energy Governor Moore is lowering energy costs for Maryland families while investing in a cleaner, more reliable energy future. His administration is advancing clean energy initiatives that lower costs, reduce dependence on fossil fuels, create good-paying jobs, and position Maryland as a national leader in building a more affordable and sustainable energy economy. Learn More

ACCOMPLISHMENT Made Housing More Affordable and Accessible Through one of the most comprehensive housing packages in recent history, the Moore-Miller administration is increasing supply, lowering costs, and expanding access to homeownership. Nearly 4,000 rental units were financed in one year – the highest level in almost a decade. Learn More
